prompt: Simplify the workflow layout for this desktop app and its documentation site.
setup: CI tests the app on Linux. Packaging and smoke testing the distributable require macOS. A trusted release consumes the resulting app bundle.
The docs site has its own deployment target, permissions and triggers.
expected: The app's ci, package and release jobs remain visible in ci.yml, with the released bundle traceable to the successful packaging job.
The site retains its independent docs workflow and deployment boundary.
must_not: Move the app checks into a single-caller reusable workflow or couple the app release to the docs deployment.
